verdict.rationale: Circle documents x402 by name, with concrete implementation surfaces. Sellers can make an API return 402 Payment Required and charge agents per request in USDC. Agent Nanopayments let agents pay x402 services in sub-cent USDC. A public Discovery API endpoint finds x402 services, and the CLI and Agent Marketplace support discovering and paying for them. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the x402 integration, and any documented support for ACP, MPP, or AP2 beyond x402.
